Name: WolfDogMod
Author: VoidedAbyss01
Description:
[size=3][b][u]My Goal of this Mod[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]I'm a Games Design student at university, and I've developed this mod as part of my coursework project.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]I'm currently prototyping the wolves in my mod for Stardew Valley and would value your feedback for my prototyping report analysis, which relies on survey responses.[/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[size=3][b][u]For Anyone Interested in Participating in being a Play Tester for My Mod (If not, skip this part)[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]CLOSED! Thank you to everyone that particpated![/*]
[/list][line]
[size=3][b][u]Description[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#d4d4d8]My mod allows you to add wolves to Stardew Valley as a new added enemy. This has been a project for me, as well as part of my university coursework, to get involved with modding and now I am currently prototyping and playtesting it.[/color][/size]
[line]
[size=3][b][u]Installation Instructions[/u][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][color=#d4d4d8]Download WolfDogMod folder (After installing SMAPI)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#d4d4d8]Unzip/Extract the mod file within the Stardew Valley Mods file[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#d4d4d8]The mod should load within your game[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#d4d4d8]If installed correctly, wolves should appear somewhat around your farm, around the Wizard's Tower, and occasionally in the village.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[size=3][b][u]Main Features[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#d4d4d8]Wolves are present in the game on your farm and will attack you, being an added enemy.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#d4d4d8]Wolf fur variants compose of: (1) Black with yellow eyes, (2) White with blue eyes, and (3) Grey with red eyes.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#d4d4d8]The wolves are programmed to attack the player when sensed, but feel free to alter them in the files.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#d4d4d8]The wolves are appearing almost everywhere on the map currently, but they are most common in the village, around the Wizard's Tower and as you exit your farm.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#d4d4d8]The wolves have no current drops.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#d4d4d8]The code may be tweaked if you want to add more spawning or change anything to make the gameplay a more enjoyable experience.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#d4d4d8]My Mod is compatible with SMAPI versions of 4.0.0.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[size=3][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url] (4.0.0 or higher) is a must have requirement in order for my mod to load into your game.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] is also a must have for the assets to load and make the wolves appear.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] allows you to adjust wolf spawn rates, health, damage, and chicken theft probability in-game without having to edit the JSON files.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url] which is useful for testing the mechanics such as the time manipulation while debugging spawn issues.[/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[size=3][b][u]Known Issues[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b][color=#cc0000]Wolves not spawning?[/color] [/b]Make sure that the option for "spawning monsters" is selected in your mod menu. Currently, the wolves are present in any farm, but this needs to be selected in order for them to spawn.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#cc0000][b]Chickens not being stolen?[/b][/color] Ensure coop doors are open and chickens are outside/in an unsecured area at night.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][color=#cc0000]Config changes not applying?[/color][/b] Delete old JSON files after updating to prevent null reference errors.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][color=#cc0000]Game crashes on launch?[/color][/b] Verify SMAPI is version 4.0+, game is updated to 1.6, and all dependencies are installed.[/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[size=3][b][u]Further Improvements for this Mod[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]These are just some checkboxes I want to work on in the coming future, but as I am in university and my schedule gets compacted, it may take a while. However, these are the changes I want to implement in the future:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Improving the wolves visual designs compared to their current ones.[/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[size=3][b][u]Important Note[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]If there is anything I missed, please feel free to comment it. Like I said, this is a voluntary participation for playtesting, and you can withdraw at any time. My mod may appear to have some bugs or incorrections, but I appreciate any criticism, advice, or just general comments on my mod. All I ask is that your comments are respectful and appropriate.[/size]
[size=3]Thank you and I hope you enjoy playing with my mod![/size]

Manifest.Name: WolfDogMod
Manifest.Description: Adds night-hunting wolves to the Wilderness Farm that can attack the player and steal unattended chickens.
